posts.text: The Senate needs to get Voter ID over the finish line. It’s that simple.

Pausing the federal tax on BOTH gas and diesel ensures Americans see savings directly at the pump and in the goods they buy every day. When the cost of diesel comes down, businesses spend less on transporting goods, which means lower prices and more savings for hard-working American families.

My American Families Gas Tax Relief Act (H.R. 8795) not only pauses the federal gas and diesel tax for 120 days but also grants the Treasury Department enforcement authority to ensure the benefit reaches consumers and does not disappear between the tax code and the gas pump.

Voter ID and the SAVE Act have overwhelming bipartisan support, yet @LeaderJohnThune continues to block it. President Trump mandated this get done, and I’ll make sure the SAVE Act is included in FISA or housing. Thune cannot ignore it now.

Video

Gas prices directly impact every American. We need to put party politics aside and pass my American Families Gas Tax Relief Act (H.R. 8795) to temporarily remove the federal gas tax for 120 days, taking 18 cents off gas and 24 cents off diesel. This is commonsense legislation.
